cards.title: Ward Vision — ART
cards.subtitle: Active Recovery Triad
cards.body: At IVB High Care, we work according to ART: the Active Recovery Triad method.

phases.title: First week of admission
phases.desc: Intake interview, physical examination and blood tests.

phases.title: Diagnostic phase
phases.desc: Carrying out assessments and questionnaires, and setting observation goals.

phases.title: Treatment phase
phases.desc: Based on all findings, you will receive a personal treatment plan.

cards.title: Not Allowed in Your Room
cards.subtitle: Prohibited items
cards.body: Clothing & shoes: only what fits in the wardrobe.

cards.title: Smoking
cards.subtitle: Only in designated outdoor areas
cards.body: Smoking is only allowed in the designated areas on the grounds.
cards.warning: If you smoke in your bedroom, your tobacco will be confiscated for 24 hours.

cards.title: Patient Confidential Adviser (PVP)
cards.subtitle: Independent and confidential
cards.body: Do you have questions or complaints? You can contact the PVP.
